attributes.name: hotel_id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for each hotel.

attributes.name: address
attributes.description: The full address of the hotel.

attributes.name: area
attributes.description: The area or district of the city where the hotel is located.

attributes.name: price_range
attributes.description: The price range of the hotel, categorized as cheap, moderate, or expensive.

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: The star rating of the hotel, indicating its quality and amenities.

attributes.name: free_wifi
attributes.description: A boolean indicating whether the hotel offers free Wi-Fi.

attributes.name: free_parking
attributes.description: A boolean indicating whether the hotel offers free parking.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of accommodation, such as hotel, guesthouse, or bed and breakfast.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: The contact phone number of the hotel.

attributes.name: postcode
attributes.description: The postal code of the hotel's location.
